question: Wilhelm-san viewed Subaru as an ordinary person who had crossed the line of death several times, but viewed through the Divine Protection of Wind Reading, what was Crusch-sama’s initial impression of Subaru?
answer: Crusch-sama’s Divine Protection of “Wind Reading” lets her view the flow of another person’s emotions as though she was reading the wind, so if Subaru was a mighty warrior, or just a NEET shut-in, when he’s picking his nose, he just looks like a guy who’s picking his nose.
